site.real_title_description: Here are my previous real world projects I've worked on.
site.practice_title_description: Here are some practice examples for reference.

project1.title: Task Management App
project1.description: A full-stack task management solution with React.js and AWS. Features include google login, task assignment, template management, and progress tracking.

project2.title: Event Company Website
project2.description: A responsive website for an event management company built with Vue.js, Firebase and AWS. It offers event calendar, artist profiles, backend management.

project3.title: Nutrition Education Australia
project3.description: A responsive website for a nutrition education organisation built with Vue, Firebase and AWS. It offers nutrition consultation booking service, recipe listing, and backend management.
